scope: Real compiled CompiledUtf16V1 functions in an owned DSO through production Core binding/executor/UTF-16 code; does not invoke a UE engine
source_state: modified working tree; selected compiled inputs compared before and after execution

android.hardening: NDK defaults; no separate BTI/PAC/CFI/MTE options or validation; no pointer normalization, signal recovery, process dumpability or page-permission changes

configurations.name: host-sanitized
configurations.sanitizers: ASan and UBSan on executable and owned module; no macOS LeakSanitizer claim

executed_contracts: Absent owner, unknown signature, wrong module allocator, stale identity/layout/generation and excessive output bounds reject before invocation
One binding permits one invocation owner and prevents recursive invocation
Native invocation and paired allocation/release execute on the attached owner
Successful, empty and surrogate-pair UTF-16 output converts to owned UTF-8
Same-path or same-device/inode multiple normal linker instances are rejected; Android FORCE_LOAD executes both-instance refusal and unique-instance recovery
Wrong pointers, capacity/count corruption, missing terminator and malformed surrogate sequences produce no partial output
Invocation errors and C++ exceptions release exactly the recorded allocation
Queue overflow, queued task cancellation and executor cancellation are observable
Owner and callback waits reject Busy; concurrent drain waits for native return and queued object lease destruction
Cancellation during invocation or allocator release and generation invalidation discard late output
Deadline crossing during native invocation discards output after matching release
Binding preserves a real normal-linker reference after the caller closes its reference; completion releases request leases; module can unload; new binding generation increases on reload
Returned result values do not permit mutation of stored completion state
production_consumer: DumperBridge unknown/custom text layout admission uses EngineSignature::Unknown and no binding, preserving Unsupported. No production game profile registers a compiled text shim.
unverified: Actual UE engine signatures, objects, allocators and game-thread integration
Raw engine FString ownership transfer; this API requires a compiled copy shim
Manually mapped modules or external unmapping/modification
DSO unloading while accepted native calls remain active
Apple binding concurrent with other module load/unload operations; integration must serialize those operations
Other operating systems or Android devices/page sizes
Independently enabled BTI/PAC/CFI/MTE and Android ThreadSanitizer
source_scope: All Core implementation and public headers, CMake graph, and owned engine fixture sources. Runtime coverage is confined to the compiled shim and executor contracts listed below; other Core archive members and public headers are supporting compilation inputs.
